description: The plot illustrates the relationship between activated parameters ratio and eval PPL for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 100 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL” and has a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  A dashed red line, labeled “Transformer”, starts at approximately 11.6 at an activated parameters ratio of 100 and decreases to approximately 11.4 at a ratio of 25. A solid gray line with circular markers, labeled “Only MoHD FFN”, begins at approximately 12.2 at an activated parameters ratio of 100, decreases to approximately 12.1 at a ratio of 75, then decreases to approximately 11.8 at a ratio of 50, and finally increases to approximately 12.0 at a ratio of 25. A solid blue line with circular markers, labeled “Only MoHD ATTN”, starts at approximately 13.2 at an activated parameters ratio of 100, decreases to approximately 13.1 at a ratio of 75, then decreases to approximately 12.2 at a ratio of 50, and finally increases to approximately 13.1 at a ratio of 25. A solid cyan line with cross markers, labeled “MoHD ATTN + MLP”, begins at approximately 13.2 at an activated parameters ratio of 100, decreases to approximately 13.0 at a ratio of 75, then decreases to approximately 12.4 at a ratio of 50, and finally increases to approximately 13.2 at a ratio of 25.
